r1_history.r1_result: FAIL — efficiency 0.0 at all SNRs, both detectors
r1_history.r1_root_cause: (a) zero-padded pre-onset window destroyed tau estimation; (b) cluster tau averaging over mixed poles
r1_history.r1_fix: pencil runs on post-onset segment only; cluster tau from strongest member

frozen_constants.waveform: A exp(-(t-t0)/tau) sin(2 pi f (t-t0)) [t>=t0]; A from sqrt(sum(h^2))/sigma_whitened = SNR
frozen_constants.detection: pencil cluster within f_tol of injected f AND rel tau error <= tau_tol AND cluster amp >= offsource amp-99%

statistical_notes.efficiency_uncertainty: binomial sigma at 0.9 with n=20 is ~0.067 — floors are set above that resolution
statistical_notes.false_alarm_note: 200 bootstrap resamples constrain FA >= 0.005 only at ~2-sigma; very small FA cannot be certified with this budget (declared honestly)
